thread:
ashley: Heads up — BlueCedar reached out about hosting + marketplace listing. They want hosted API, dedicated capacity option, and a co-announcement. Need licensing/distro terms nailed down before their embargo window next Thu. @raj can you grab a copy of their license and any attestation docs?
raj: On it. Asking for the model license + training data provenance. Also flagging export controls for EU/UK/US.
kevin: Early read: they attached a CC-BY-NC-SA with a proposed commercial addendum. That combination could block paid listings on some marketplaces.
sophia: Is BlueCedar ok with us re-quantizing weights and producing a 8-bit variant? That's key for our Dedicated offering.
tom-partner: From BlueCedar: they permit hosting and permissive transformations for inference performance (quantization allowed) but require attribution and a 10% gross rev-share on marketplace sales. Embargo: 14 days pre-announce.
elaine-legal: Need a signed redistribution addendum + provenance attestation. We'll also need an explicit clause for third-party SI integrations (SI can bundle but must pass our distro checks). Drafting a short addendum template now.
nash: (note: not in thread)
nash removed — ignore
kevin: Quick check: revenue-share + CC-BY-NC-SA is messy. If they want commercial revenue share, license should be permissive or dual-licensed. Elaine, can legal propose language to keep listing eligible?
elaine-legal: Yes — propose dual-license: vendor retains original CC-BY-NC-SA for downloads, but grants Redwood a commercial hosting license for marketplace and dedicated serving under a separate Commercial Hosting Agreement (CHA). CHA will include attribution, rev-share, and embargo terms.
nash: (bot)
deploy-bot: New ticket created PARTNR-4821: "BlueCedar CHA + provenance attestation" — assigning to @elaine-legal and @raj.
nash: (ignore)
ashley: Ops/technical checklist: 1) Confirm ability to re-quantize (kevin) 2) Package signing + weight signer verification 3) KMS/HSM requirement for private images? 4) Region geoblock list (EU/UK only vs global) 5) SI integration playbook for co-sells
kevin: Re-quantize: confirmed technical feasibility. We'll produce 8-bit and 4-bit QC variants but must keep original weights signed. Need signer key and recommended canonical hash in the CHA.
sophia: For KMS: they asked for customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. We'll propose optional KMS integration and note Hosted marketplace will use Redwood-managed KMS with customer key escrow if requested.
tom-partner: BlueCedar also requests a short announcement runbook and wants us to coordinate channel partner messaging with their marketing.
elaine-legal: Draft CHA will include: allowed transformations (quantization, pruning), attribution language, rev-share terms, embargo window (14 days), export compliance warranty, weight-signing requirement, and a clause letting Redwood create optimized binaries for inference.
nash: signatures: tom-partner will send legal contact name.
tom-partner: Sending contact: legal@bluecedar.ai. They'll sign the addendum once we share the draft.
nash: (system)
ashley: Next steps: Raj — collect license + provenance docs by EOD tomorrow. Elaine — draft CHA by Friday. Kevin — confirm signing workflow and add hashing spec to PARTNR-4821. Sophia — prepare KMS integration options doc for Monday. I'll coordinate announcement runbook with BlueCedar once CHA is under review. :thumbsup:
raj: Ack, on it.
kevin: Adding hash spec to PARTNR-4821 now.
sophia: Will share KMS options Monday morning.
elaine-legal: Draft will be in the ticket for review. If anyone has required wording for attribution or rev-share formula, ping me here.
nash: (bot)
deploy-bot: PARTNR-4821 updated: assignees set to elaine-legal, raj, kevin, sophia.
nash: (end)
